evidence_templates: The page is published on GOV.UK by UKHSA, NHS England or another named UK public authority.
The page was live-opened successfully on 1 August 2026.
The URL passed the GOV.UK official-domain allowlist.
The URL was absent from all eight repository slug-uniqueness query groups for the previous 539 source families.
Operational use requires confirmation of the current page version, responsible organisations, affected people, setting, timing and supporting evidence.
The source must be interpreted within its stated population, disease, setting, period, methodology and response function.
An alert, test result, symptom report, notification, surveillance count, questionnaire or checklist alone does not establish that every recommendation applies.
Final decisions require the current official scope plus exact clinical, laboratory, epidemiological, environmental, operational, communication, governance and review evidence.
